questions.question: What were the total nominal food-at-home expenditures in millions of dollars in 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_row]]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()
data = data[pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce').notna()]
data['Year'] = data['Year'].astype(int)

row_2020 = data[data['Year'] == 2020]
col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Total food-at-home expenditures' in c][0]
result = float(row_2020[col].values[0])

questions.question: In 2021, by how much did total nominal food-away-from-home expenditures exceed total nominal food-at-home expenditures, in millions of dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_row]]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()
data = data[pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce').notna()]
data['Year'] = data['Year'].astype(int)

row_2021 = data[data['Year'] == 2021]
fafh_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Total food-away-from-home expenditures' in c][0]
fah_col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Total food-at-home expenditures' in c][0]

questions.question: In which year did total nominal spending on food away from home first surpass one trillion dollars (1,000,000 million dollars)?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_row]]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()
data = data[pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce').notna()]
data['Year'] = data['Year'].astype(int)

col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Total food-away-from-home expenditures' in c][0]
data[col] = pd.to_numeric(data[col])
surpassed = data[data[col] > 1000000].sort_values('Year')
result = str(surpassed['Year'].iloc[0])

questions.question: Did alcohol sales at eating and drinking places drop in 2020 compared to 2019?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_row]]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()
data = data[pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce').notna()]
data['Year'] = data['Year'].astype(int)

col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Alcohol sales at eating and drinking places' in c][0]
val_2019 = float(data[data['Year'] == 2019][col].values[0])
val_2020 = float(data[data['Year'] == 2020][col].values[0])
result = 'yes' if val_2020 < val_2019 else 'no'

questions.question: Between 1997 and 2025, how many years saw total away-from-home alcohol sales exceed 100,000 million nominal dollars?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_row]]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()
data = data[pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce').notna()]
data['Year'] = data['Year'].astype(int)

col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Total alcohol-away-from-home sales' in c][0]
data[col] = pd.to_numeric(data[col])
result = int((data[col] > 100000).sum())

questions.question: Which three years had the highest nominal food sales at full-service restaurants?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_food_expenditure_series_nominal.xlsx', sheet_name='Nominal expenditures', header=None)
header_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Year'].index[0]
df.columns = [str(c).strip() for c in df.iloc[header_row]]
data = df.iloc[header_row + 1:].copy()
data = data[pd.to_numeric(data['Year'], errors='coerce').notna()]
data['Year'] = data['Year'].astype(int)

col = [c for c in data.columns if 'Food sales at full-service restaurants' in c][0]
data[col] = pd.to_numeric(data[col])
top3 = data.sort_values(col, ascending=False).head(3)
result = [str(y) for y in top3['Year'].tolist()]
